spans.s:
स्नु mn. (-स्नुः-स्नु)
 1. Table-land, the level summit or edge of a mountain.
2. Top, surface in general; this word has no forms for the first
five cases; according to Vopadeva it is an optional substitute
for सानु.
 f. (-स्नुः) A sinew, tendon, muscle.
 E. ष्णु to trickle, (the
water or snow from it,) डु aff.; or ष्णा to bathe, कु Unādi aff.

स्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowing, dropping, oozing, trickling, distilled. E.
ष्णु to ooze, aff. क्त ।

स्नुषा f. (-षा)
 1. A daughter-in-law.
 2. The milk-hedge-plant.
 E. ष्णु to distil, Unādi aff. सक् ।

स्नुह् f. (-स्नुक्) The milk-hedge-plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum. &c.) E.
स्नुह् to vomit, (its milk being used as an emetic,) aff. क्विप्; also
with टाप् added, स्नुहा ।

स्नुहि f. (-हिः-ही) A plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum.)
 E. ष्णुह् to vomit:
(see the last,) कि aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
